id: \rBulbasaur here takes care of this village alongside me.
en: \rBulbasaur here takes care of this village alongside me.
it: \rBulbasaur si prende cura di questo villaggio insieme a me.

id: \rHowever, I want Bulbasaur to experience the outside world.\nWould you take Bulbasaur with you?
en: \rHowever, I want Bulbasaur to experience the outside world.\nWould you take Bulbasaur with you?
it: \rPerò vorrei che Bulbasaur conoscesse il mondo esterno.\nPorteresti Bulbasaur con te?

id: \rI care a lot about this forest and the Pokémon living inside it.
en: \rI care a lot about this forest and the Pokémon living inside it.
it: \rTengo molto a questa foresta e ai Pokémon che ci vivono.

id: Head east here to reach Route 24!
en: Head east here to reach Route 24!
it: Vai a est da qui per raggiungere il Percorso 24!
